name: petdex
description: A pet from the petdex.dev gallery sits on the input field of the open session and shows what it does: working, it runs; asking you, it waves; failed, it is sad; done with a turn, it jumps. Thousands of pets to pick from: "Settings" → "Pet"
why: You see the session's state out of the corner of your eye, and the hub is more fun: the same pet you have in Codex or Claude Code
